reviews.text: Namaste anytime. Love this app, I use primarily in my yoga room on Roku. I can walk two minutes into my private class with Alana. Alana and Nathan are fabulous instructors.

GRATITUDE. I’m grateful for the creators of this platform.
All thanks to God for you and more blessings!!

Porque no en otros idiomas. Buenas tardes. Cada día la globalización nos.arropa y todavía siguen haciendo aplicaciónes para un solo Target de personas.en cuánto al idioma. Por favor incluyan el idioma castellano o español, aunque sea en los subtítulos. Gracias

Truly Amazed. I am truly amazed at the cost of this app. I have paid more for far less. I have really been trying to get more into yogic philosophy, but, still do the physical practice as well. Yoga Anytime does a great job delivering on both. The classes on here are far beyond in depth and quality than most anything out there. This covers almost anything you would want to learn about in the realm of yoga. I personally recommend checking out James Boag’s classes. He is amazing at explaining the topics he covers.
Yoga Teacher loving your site. Enjoying I want you to anything

YogaAnytime Review. YogaAnytime complements my cycling workouts, has increased my yoga abilities and offers a university of knowledge. There are wonderful teachers, and a ridiculous number of on-demand offerings. I have returned to sessions to check my progress, or relive a breakthrough experience. In just two months my flexibility, strength and focus have incrementally improved. A veteran teacher, I am so impressed with the clarity and warmth of instruction. This is a healthy online experience, which also feels like discovering beautiful and exciting new roads on my bike.

Great variety, teachers and quality.. I love being able to catch a 5 min or 90 min class when I have the time. I can stay in poses longer or skip ahead, or change videos/classes when I want. The teachers here are amazing!! So much knowledge and teaching experience. If there’s a teacher that doesn’t fit with my desired style, I can easily find a different one for a different class. I love it!

Amazing. I cannot say enough about the experience provided by Yoga Anytime .
During the pandemic this tool is unsurpassed in delivering quality Yoga / Meditation and Self healing tools . 
A lifesaver !

Learn a new style. I have been practicing yoga for around 20 years. It has been challenging this year to join in on all the zoom classes as a big part of my practice is enjoying my Kula and having the community experience.
While I was searching on YouTube a kundalini pats rice I came upon Sukahdev and yoga anytime. Now I am hooked and not only enjoying my kundalini practice, also open to experience the entire menu that yoga anytime has to offer.
Such a wonderful app that I highly recommend.
Namaste

Great app. I really appreciate the shows feature, as it allows me to choose a course that fits my experience. For example, I’m a teacher and currently feeling a lot of stress and burnout. I started the yoga for anxiety show and it is very helpful. I especially appreciate that the shows are like courses, and not just one class that I’d have to repeat every day. I thought I would just try it for a week and then cancel because of the cost, but it is definitely worth the monthly expense.
A comforting and inspiring companion. Yes, that covers it! I’ve renewed because I use it, it’s diverse in content, and I love to support our local business and many local teachers.
Great videos. The content is great and keeps me coming back. The limited search function and non user friendly app does not. I also wish it tracked my progress in some way.
Life changing. Especially during covid

This app is awesome!. I started using YogaAnytime when I moved from California to upstate New York, a big step toward true love but far away from my go-to yoga studios. I wasn’t sure how I was going to continue my yoga education and was so delighted to find this platform with so many world-class teachers and thoughtfully curated courses! The mobile app makes it possible for me to learn or practice anywhere I have phone service. I love the option to share classes with friends who are not yet on the platform and am quick to recommend it to anyone who wants to begin or deepens their yoga practice. Thank you YogaAnytime!!
Terrific resource. So many options - on my phone!!

Amazinggggggg. I have been to Yoga classes for at least $80/month. For $20 a month, you get MORE than going to an actual studio! In the comfort of your home! I have been using this app for well over 6 months and have noticed a tremendous difference in my strength!

Love it!. This app saves me so much money. The quality and variety of the classes is fantastic! Plus I have the convenience of practicing in my own home! No need to go and pay $20 on a yoga class and break the bank! I can afford to do yoga more often!

The only yoga app I need. I've tried other yoga apps and online sources. This is the only one I've stuck with. There is a depth of content that doesn't exist anywhere else. More than just yoga movement classes, you'll find info on meditation, Ayurveda, Sanskrit, mantras, mudras and more. Wonderful, insightful teachers. I'm a huge fan.

Excellent app!. This is the one thing that has gotten me into a daily practice. Excellent teachers, ability to filter specific needs, like duration, props, level, and style. Many learning opportunities... the list goes on. I thought I'd cancel after the free trial, but it is worth every penny. I have not had one class I didn't like, and I am very picky, having practiced on and off for 17 years.
Excellent for busy moms and dads. I can easily practice yoga on a busy schedule. Thank you!

Useful and comprehensive. I am new to yoga and have tried several yoga apps (Grokker, Cody, YogaGlo and Serenity Yin Yoga). I liked them all but this is my favorite. There are dozens of "programs" you can watch, each composed of 4-15 episodes on a certain topic, usually delivered by the same teacher. I am interested in yin yoga so was delighted to find 15 episodes of a yin/restorative class called "wait for it." Many flavors of asanas are represented (Ashtanga, Vinyasa, Hatha etc) and there are also sitting meditations, pranayama, singing, and talks and lectures on topics from anatomy to the Bhagavad Gita. You can leave comments on class videos and the teachers will write you back, which is pretty awesome. 

So yeah: you can go deep into learning stuff or you can just swoop in and do a meditation or workout. You can follow one teacher or try a new one each day of the week. And it costs the same as a single visit to a yoga studio costs in my town. The internet is amazing!
Great app!. This is a great app. The classes are easy to follow along and there is a lot of variety to keep it interesting for me.

👍🏼👍🏼👍🏼👍🏼👍🏼. I love this app for all my yoga needs. Can practice from anywhere in my house anytime I want. Also like that I can download a practice on wifi, save it, & watch it later to save on data. 💁🏻 🙌🏼

Yoga Flow Show!. Yes! I just took a class with Jasmine Tarkeshi on the Yoga Flow Show and I feel blissed out, energized, and ready to go! **Note to the developers, the "watch offline" feature hangs up after just one--it won't move through a cue of downloads. Check it out please. ,) 

Om shanti!
I love Yoga Anytime. I like be this little app, I can always find a class for exactly what I need. Typically I just want a quick series in the mornings and have found a lot of options.
Too expensive in Canadian $$ but... ...it’s an excellent app if you can afford it. There’s a lot to choose from with excellent instructors.
Great variety. Easy to find an instructor and series to suit my practice, even as my needs change. So glad I subscribed!
